decisions: EVERY NUMBER COMES FROM A VIEW. The page never re-derives a metric. If a number is missing the fix is a migration, not a join added to the page.
security_invoker=true on every view. These were the first views in this schema and a default view runs as OWNER, bypassing RLS on 68 tables. Verified 24/24 invoker, 0 anon-readable.
Revenue is accrual and 'confirmed' means confirmed_at is not null, NOT status='confirmed' - a status filter hid 26,550 of 70,650 (38%).
Purchases are NEVER a P&L line. Receipts are ~57x consumption over the same window; expensing both would overstate cost enormously.
Ratios recompute from period totals in SQL, never averaged. Q3 margin is -38.7% correct vs +20.5% averaged - it flips the sign.
people_missing_salary and trucks_active are NOT additive and are never summed. trucks_active currently sums to the right answer BY COINCIDENCE, which is worse than a visible error.
The driver is measured, the truck is display-only context. No truck-level figure appears in a driver row.
Migration files were RECONCILED to what actually ran (0099/0100/0101 each applied in modified form). Do not 'fix' them back toward the drafts.
